address: 3175 San Bruno Ave, San Francisco, CA
text: Welcome to 3175 San Bruno Ave, located on the Sunny side of town! A 4-bedroom 2 bath move in ready single-family home that features a spacious and flexible layout. The entry level has 2 generous sized bedrooms and full bathroom. Upstairs, a spacious living room, formal dining room and eat in kitchen as well as 2 more bedrooms, including the primary and a full bath. The interior has been freshly painted, new LVP flooring, newer appliances, updates to the roof and plumbing. This home is a commuter's dream! Other amenities include close proximity to San Bruno Ave shops and restaurants, and McLaren Park- San Francisco's second largest park with approximately 314 acres of open space complete with hiking and bike trails, sports courts, a hummingbird farm and the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater. Additional features include a landscaped back yard with established fruit trees and flowers, 2 car side by side garage and laundry. This home has been in the same family since it was built, it has been well cared for and thoughtfully updated but is ready for its next chapter.

Discover an exquisitely reimagined, fully detached residence in San Francisco's coveted Parkside neighborhood. Meticulously transformed with uncompromising attention to detail, this home offers 2,383 square feet of luxury where timeless elegance meets contemporary refinement. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 4.5 designer bathrooms, including 3 private en-suite retreats, the home showcases rich engineered wood floors, an abundance of natural light, and bespoke custom closets in every bedroom. The heart of the home is an open-concept chef's kitchen, appointed with a premium suite of Viking appliances and exquisite finishes, flowing seamlessly into expansive living and dining areas. It's ideal for everything from intimate evenings to grand celebrations. The lower level adds a welcoming family lounge with a stylish wet bar, perfect for entertaining, movie nights, or a private retreat. Enjoy nearby parks, the charming cafs, eateries, and boutiques of West Portal, the shopping and dining of Stonestown Galleria, and convenient public transit. 2144 17th Avenue is a rare opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable residential enclaves.

This stylishly updated home at 1205 Brussels St pairs a sleek, dormered white facade with a dramatic wrought-iron gated entry featuring a bold circular motif, offering both privacy and curb appeal alongside the attached garage. Inside, freshly finished flooring flows into an open living room with statement pendant lighting and on to a well-equipped kitchen. Remodeled with permits and designed by a professional designer, the kitchen showcases walnut-toned cabinetry, black countertops, a green glass tile backsplash, and stainless-steel appliances including a gas range with hood. The lower bedroom is generously proportioned, featuring a sliding glass door that opens to a spacious deck. An en-suite bath and a bright sitting area perfectly complement the space. Upstairs, you'll find second and third bedrooms offering bright, light-filled retreats with wood flooring, while a tiled powder room and an additional full bath add convenience. The bathrooms have been updated with new vanities and fresh essentials. Outside, a low-maintenance rear yard with mature trees and a wood deck provides a peaceful spot to unwind. A stellar example of 1959-quality construction and design, this home blends vintage character with modern style. Schedule a showing today to experience this home in person.

Welcome to 1483 47th Avenue, a beautifully remodeled Outer Sunset residence where exceptional craftsmanship, sophisticated design, and coastal living come together. Remodeled to the highest standards, this stunning home features raised ceilings and expansive skylights that flood the interior with natural light, creating a bright, open, and inviting atmosphere throughout. The upper level showcases two generously sized bedrooms and a beautifully appointed designer bathroom. At the heart of the home, the spacious living room, dining area, and kitchen blend seamlessly in a thoughtfully designed open-concept layout, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The chef's kitchen is a true centerpiece, featuring premium Thermador appliances, an oversized island, and a gorgeous quartz waterfall countertop, complemented by refined finishes and exceptional attention to detail. The lower level expands the home's versatility with an additional family room, a well-appointed bedroom, and a stylish designer bathroom. These inviting living spaces flow effortlessly to a beautifully landscaped rear yard, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing in your own private retreat. Beyond its exceptional interiors, this home enjoys an enviable Outer Sunset location, just moments from the Pacific Ocean and the natural beauty of Ocean Beach, Sunset Dunes Park, and Golden Gate Park. Whether enjoying a coastal stroll, cycling along scenic paths, or exploring the city's expansive green spaces, outdoor recreation is always close at hand. The neighborhood's vibrant local scene offers an outstanding selection of beloved destinations, including Gus's Community Market for everyday essentials, Hook Fish Co. for fresh seafood, Outerlands for a memorable dining experience, Black Bird Bookstore for literary discoveries, and Mullusk and Aqua Surf Shop for surf-inspired style and coastal essentials. The surrounding neighborhood offers a welcoming community atmosphere, independent businesses, and the relaxed character that makes the Outer Sunset so desirable. Commuting is equally convenient, with the nearby N Judah providing direct access to downtown San Francisco and connections throughout the city. A rare opportunity to enjoy a high-end remodel, versatile living spaces, exceptional indoor-outdoor flow, and the best of San Francisco's coastal lifestyleall in one remarkable home.

Some homes invite you to slow down. Reimagined with quiet confidence and an eye for craftsmanship, this Bernal Heights retreat feels warm and considered from the moment you enter. White oak millwork by Snakecraft, deep green accents, and natural textures carry a sense of continuity from room to room. Light moves through the open main level, where the kitchen, dining, and living spaces flow toward the patio. A custom oak banquette makes room for slow mornings and long dinners with friends. Handmade Fireclay tile, Miele appliances, and discreet storage bring beauty and purpose to the kitchen. A guest room and office shifts easily between work and welcome, its Murphy bed folding into an upholstered sofa. Three bedrooms on record, the home is currently configured as two, with the former third bedroom incorporated into the expanded living space. A full bath completes the level. Sonos audio sets the mood throughout every room and the outdoor spaces. The lower level offers a quieter rhythm. A serene primary suite with a soaking tub, generous shower, and outdoor access creates a retreat within the home, while a flexible bonus space with garage access and dedicated laundry bring ease to daily life. Outside, the home unfolds across three tiers of outdoor living. A sculptural outdoor kitchen and terraced succulent gardens lead to a sun-warmed upper deck, sheltered from the wind and open to sweeping Bay views. It's a place for reading, gathering, or simply watching the light change over the city. With Cortland Avenue's neighborhood favorites downhill and Bernal Heights Park uphill, this is a home that feels both connected to the city and wonderfully apart from it.

Stunning Modern Luxury Home with Spectacular Bay and City Views! Welcome to 511 Lakeview Avenue, an exceptional modern residence built in 2023, offering approximately 3,366 square feet of luxurious living space in San Francisco's desirable Oceanview neighborhood. This impressive four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom home showcases contemporary architecture, elegant finishes, and breathtaking panoramic Bay and city views. Designed with comfort and sophistication in mind, the home features a spacious open living environment, beautiful engineered hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, elegant chandeliers, and electric fireplaces on multiple levels. The gourmet chef's kitchen is equipped with premium Viking stainless-steel appliances, including a gas range, oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, and wine refrigerator. Stylish cabinetry, quartz countertops, and thoughtfully designed spaces make this kitchen ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The generously sized bedrooms offer comfort and privacy, while the beautifully appointed bathrooms feature modern finishes and illuminated mirrors. A radiant floor heating system provides customized comfort throughout the home. Additional highlights include custom window shutters, tankless water heater, an attached garage with a 220V outlet for electric vehicle charging, and inviting outdoor spaces. Conveniently located near public transportation, shopping, dining, schools, and major commuter routes, this extraordinary property offers the perfect combination of modern luxury, comfort, and city convenience. A Rare Opportunity to Own a Spectacular Modern San Francisco Home. Must See!

Situated in the Outer Mission, this beautifully refreshed Marina-style home features a flexible two-level layout perfect for modern living, working, and active lifestyles. The light-filled upper level showcases hardwood floors, detailed crown molding, and a classic brick fireplace in the spacious living room. A seamless open flow leads into the formal dining room, which connects directly to a bright eat-in kitchen with wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and granite countertops. Two comfortable bedrooms, a pristine full bath, and premium top-down, bottom-up honeycomb blinds throughout complete this level. The versatile lower level features a bonus room and bathroom suite ideal for extended living, a home office, long-term guests, or rental potential. This level also includes a large attached garage providing secure vehicle parking and immense additional storage capacity. Commuters will love the freeway access, while residents will enjoy being directly across the street from the upcoming Aisle 19, a massive new climbing gym, fitness center, yoga studio, and sauna facility. Conveniently located close to local restaurants and public transportation, this move-in-ready property perfectly captures the vibrant energy and convenience of San Francisco living.

Imagine Excelsior. A little more sunshine, a little more space, and a neighborhood full of character waiting to be discovered. Welcome to 422 Vienna Street, a charming and beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath home offering approximately 1,000 square feet of comfortable living. Classic San Francisco details meet thoughtful updates, including refreshed kitchen and bathroom floors, new kitchen appliances, and double-pane windows. The real magic is out back: a beautifully landscaped garden, perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, gardening, or simply soaking up the sunshine. Downstairs, a spacious garage level with excellent ceiling height offers remarkable versatilityroom for a casual hangout, workshop, laundry, and storage, with direct access to the garden and exciting possibilities for the future. Beyond the front door, discover the personality of Excelsior: colorful murals, independent coffee shops, neighborhood wine bars, beloved pupuserias, Vietnamese sandwiches, sushi, Thai food, and an eclectic collection of local businesses. All set among quiet residential streets with a genuine sense of community.

Red Hot NOPA location: these units are selling at record prices. This one is priced transparently. Amazing Southern and Western exposure in this very large 3-bed, 2-full-bath, top-floor, full-floor (all on one level) flat. Huge level shared south-facing yard. Independent garage parking.

Brand-new, complete down-to-studs renovation at 474 27th Ave, at Clement Street in San Francisco's Central Richmond district. Parking, In-Unit Washer and Dryer. Photos are of the model unit, not this unit. $11K Meile/Bosch appliance package. The all-new bathroom, with modern finishes, features a deep soaking tub. The building has new electrical service, a new roof, new paint, and a new high-end entry system with facial recognition. All-new 1-beds: $699K; 2-beds: $1.299M; and studios: $499K, all with parking and in-unit washer/dryers.

address: 1107 Rhode Island St, San Francisco, CA
text: Exceptional upside potential in Potrero Hill. This home sits on a huge 5,800 sq. ft. parcel along with the adjacent property located at 1101 Rhode Island St (APN# 4159-051). Both properties must be sold together. These two detached homes with separate addresses and separate APNs offer a rare opportunity for developers, contractors, investors, owner-users, multi-generational living, or buyers with vision seeking long-term value creation. This spacious home features 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, a living room, kitchen, family room, and a rear narrow room, all conveniently located on a single level. Additional features include very high ceilings, tall windows, abundant natural light, a rear patio, an unfinished basement, and views toward Sutro Tower. Both homes (1107 and 1101 Rhode Island St) are in livable condition but would benefit from cosmetic updating for owner-occupants. These homes are ideally located within walking distance of Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, Muni transit, and with convenient access to Whole Foods, restaurants, Downtown SF, and Highways 101 and 280, providing easy access East Bay and South Bay. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Buyers are advised to conduct their own investigations regarding development potential and the highest and best use of the property. Build or Renovate and They Will Come.

Ideally located on a flat block in Noe Valley, 326-328 27th St consists of a brand new main house + a renovated guest house, offering four levels of beautifully designed living spaces, exceptional custom finishes, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom main residence and separate 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom guest house total approximately 4,135 square feet (per graphic artist). The main residence features wide-plank wood floors, oversized windows, walls of glass, and custom stone selections throughout. An elevator connects all four levels, while Mitsubishi ceiling cassettes provide independently controlled heating and air conditioning in each room. The open main level includes generous living and dining areas and a kitchen with a Calacatta Monet stone center island, soapstone countertops, custom wood cabinetry, and Miele appliances, including an induction cooktop. Expansive glass doors open directly to the terrace and landscaped garden, creating an excellent space for indoor-outdoor entertaining. The bedroom level includes three bedrooms, highlighted by the primary suite with floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors, two walk-in closets, and a bathroom featuring a floating dual vanity, freestanding soaking tub, large walk-in shower, and heated floors. The top floor offers a spacious family room with vaulted ceilings, wet bar, and direct access to a south-facing terrace. A fourth bedroom and full bathroom provide flexibility for guests or an office. At the rear of the garden, the renovated guest house features its own entrance, private patio, bedroom, bathroom, and open living and kitchen area, ideal for extended family, office space, or a home gym. Additional features include a one-car garage with interior access, solar panels, and integrated audio.
